A `page_branch` that is not a prefix test at all reddens as `page_branch_is_not_a_prefix_test` rather than passing vacuously.

findings.rejected_scope: The orchestrator asked whether the honest repair is a grader change rather than a prose change. Judgement: prose here, grader NOT here, and the reason is in ADR-019 §6 itself. The strict form (published == ledger max) is the retroactive-reddening treadmill §6 explicitly refuses — a slower row recorded later at the same count would redden a band already published and committed. There IS a treadmill-free form (published >= max over rows at this count with `ts <= the cited ts`, which no later run can change), and it would have caught this exact defect: 002424 was cited when 002326/14.02 already stood, and 003025 is the max as of its own ts. That is logged as T-R85 with its acceptance and its watched-red plan, not implemented here (CLAUDE.md debt rule). ADR-019 §3 names T-R85 in the same paragraph, so the published claim states the gap rather than implying coverage.
